_doc: Map entry id in eta/maps.py -> the FLAG DOM field that box is rendered as. `kind` is how the extension must DRIVE the input, not what HTML tag it is.
_key: The key is the map entry id (A1, Fa8a, Hc2b), NOT the box number printed on the form. A BOX NUMBER IS NOT UNIQUE ON THE ETA-9089: Section A is Employer Information numbered A.1-A.17, and Appendix A.A is Foreign Worker Contact Information numbered A.1-A.15 all over again. Keying on the bare box number silently pointed A.1 at the foreign worker's last-name input, so the feed would have typed the employer's legal business name into the beneficiary's name box on a federal form -- no error, no blank, just wrong. The generated key therefore carries the APX prefix from the field's nav section, and the test asserts every key resolves to a real map entry in both directions.
_coverage: RADIOS ARE NOW CARRIED, for the ETA-9035E only. The first capture this file was built from (2026-07-16, the 9141 and the 9089) recorded a radio's per-option LABEL and never its `value` attribute, so no radio was listed and the guess at the time -- numeric codes -- was circumstantial. The reveal pass of 2026-10-08 read the live ETA-9035E option values directly, and FOUR radio sets on that form are now observed fact, vendored in forms/tests/fixtures/flag_eta9035_capture.json and asserted against this table on every run: F.2 is YES/NO; F.10a and F.11a are BOTH Hour/Week/Bi-Weekly/Month/Year -- the same five spellings, hyphen and all, which is NOT how the printed PDF spells them (its prevailing-wage group is 'Bi Weekly', unhyphenated, and `options` is where that difference is translated away); and F.12 is f12_is_dol_prevailing_wage / f13_is_oes_prevailing_wage / f14_non_oes_prevailing_wage. Only those four sets were observed as option values. Every other 9035E radio here carries values from the same capture file but was not part of that four-set read, and NO radio on the ETA-9141 or the ETA-9089 has been re-observed since 2026-07-16. Writing a value a React-controlled radio does not offer is ignored rather than raised, so a value not in `options` is still never written.

F11a.name: _section_f_f11a_prevailing_wage_per
F11a._options_doc: TWO KEYS FOR BI-WEEKLY, on purpose. The key is what the map emits, the value is what FLAG offers. FLAG offers the hyphenated 'Bi-Weekly' on BOTH F.10a and F.11a; the printed PDF does not -- its 'Prevailing Rate' widget state is '/Bi Weekly' while 'Paid' is '/Bi-Weekly', so preview.py speaks the PDF's spelling and hands this one 'Bi Weekly'. Both spellings are keyed so this lookup resolves whichever side is tidied first. A miss here is silent: the box simply stays blank on a federal form.

_radio_values: Radio option values come from the live reveal pass of 2026-08-17 and are NOT interchangeable between the two forms. Yes/No/N-A is "1"/"No"/"2" on the ETA-9141 and "Yes"/"No"/"N/A" on the ETA-9089 -- the same logical question, spelled differently. Writing "Yes" to a 9141 radio is ignored by React: no error, and the box stays blank on a federal form. `options` maps the value the backend map emits to the value THAT FORM's widget offers; a value not in the map is never written.

_revealed_by_doc: A box FLAG does not put on the page until another box is answered. `name` is that other box's DOM field and `values` are the answers that reveal this one, copied from the `revealedBy` the reveal-pass capture recorded, and asserted against it on every run. autofill.py HOLDS a box whose gate is unanswered or answered elsewhere, with the reason, instead of emitting it: a value written to an input that is not in the DOM is not a slow fill, it is no fill, and nothing is raised. That is how a wage level could never land -- F.13a was emitted for every case while F.12, which reveals it, was emitted for almost none.
_revealed_by_scope: ETA-9035E: only the F.12 prevailing-wage chain is enforced (the H chain was captured on one path only). ETA-9141: the reveals seen on the 2026-11-11 walk.

_revealed_by_reasons._section_f_f12_f13_f14_prevailing_wage_q: F.12 -- where the prevailing wage came from -- is not answered on this case, and FLAG does not put this box on the page until it is. Nothing is typed because there is nowhere to type it. F.12 is a legal statement about the source of the wage, so it is never guessed: answer it first and this box fills.
_revealed_by_reasons._section_f_f14a_source_type: F.14.a -- which other wage source this is -- is not answered on this case, and FLAG does not put this box on the page until it is.
